slos.title: Resize FPS
slos.measurement: Criterion sample of presented frame intervals

slos.title: Input-to-photon latency (macOS)
slos.scenario: single keystroke on a CAMetalLayer-backed window with 80x24 pane
slos.measurement: End-to-end timing from known key event through deterministic headless frame flush; CAMetalDrawable lab capture remains a target-run refinement

slos.title: Input-to-photon latency (Wayland)
slos.scenario: single keystroke on a wl_compositor-backed window with 80x24 pane
slos.measurement: End-to-end timing from known key event through deterministic headless frame flush; wl_surface commit + frame_done lab capture remains a target-run refinement

slos.title: Visual artifacts (24h adversarial fuzz)
slos.scenario: 24h randomized resize + scroll + content fuzz on R1..R4 workload classes
slos.measurement: Per-frame golden-image diff vs analytic reference; classify critical (blank/stale/severe-tear) vs minor

slos.title: Idle GPU usage
slos.target: 0% sustained when no semantic change for >500ms
slos.scenario: Idle pane with cursor disabled, no incoming PTY traffic for 30s
slos.measurement: Sampled GPU counter (Metal: GPUCommandBuffer.GPUEndTime; Vulkan: VK_EXT_calibrated_timestamps)

slos.title: Heavy-burst input latency
slos.scenario: 1MB/s sustained PTY output across 50 panes; single keystroke into focused pane
slos.measurement: End-to-end keystroke timing under output pressure

slos.title: Battery drain, 24h idle, Apple M2
slos.scenario: Apple Silicon M2 / M2 Pro laptop, idle ft window backgrounded, screen on, brightness 50%
slos.measurement: macOS pmset battery delta; Linux upower energy-rate average

slos.title: Frame skip rate (steady state)
slos.target: ≥99% frames skipped when no content change
slos.scenario: 60s steady-state idle on a 12-pane fleet with no PTY traffic

slos.title: Reflow latency
slos.measurement: Bench timer around the logical-reflow stage probe

slos.title: Atlas rebuild count on pure resize
slos.target: 0 rebuilds during a resize sequence with no glyph additions
slos.scenario: 100 sequential window-size resize events, no font/scale change, no new glyphs

slos.title: Snap-back parity (Draft → Standard)
slos.target: SSIM ≥ 0.999 between Draft-mode frame and Standard-mode reference
slos.scenario: After live-resize gesture ends, post-snap frame compared to ground-truth render at the final dimensions
slos.measurement: Per-pixel SSIM via reference renderer in tests/renderer_golden/scenarios

slos.title: Floating-pane render overhead
slos.target: < 0.5ms additional per pane vs a tiled layout of equivalent total area
slos.scenario: Same 12-pane content rendered as tiled vs floating; subtract per-frame paint cost
slos.measurement: Bench timer around paint_impl, per-pane cost via difference

slos.title: SSIM parity oracle corpus
slos.scenario: Retained GPU golden corpus self-compare plus adversarial floor audit now; ratatui oracle vs ftui subject retained driver emits per-case divergence summaries pending a clean release run
slos.measurement: Per-pixel SSIM, max L∞ channel delta, changed-pixel fraction, and G39 topology fixture cross-check via frankenterm_gui::gpu_regression::compare_images
slos.operator_surface: ft robot perf slo-status --slo ssim_parity; ft doctor --json .renderer_slos.ssim_parity
